transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?
I'm here because I've been really struggling to keep my life organized lately. It feels like no matter what I do, I just can't seem to manage my tasks or keep track of my daily schedule.
Have these problems with organization and keeping track of things been present since childhood, or did they start more recently? Was there any major stress or mood change around the time they began?

Yes, these struggles with organization have actually been going on since I was a kid, definitely before I turned 12. I don't recall any major stress or mood changes triggering them, as it has just been a long-standing issue for as long as I can remember.
Do these attention and organization problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work or school and at home, and have they caused problems with your performance or responsibilities?

I'm not quite sure, to be honest, as I haven't really thought about it in that way before. I just know that I've always struggled with it, but I haven't paid close attention to how it affects me differently at home versus work.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying about many different things, and is that worry hard to control even when you try to relax?

No, I wouldn't say I experience excessive or uncontrollable worrying about a lot of different things. My main frustration is just with my disorganization, but I don't really feel constantly anxious or worried in that way.
Have you been feeling down or losing interest in things you usually enjoy for at least two weeks, especially around the times your concentration feels worse?
No, I haven't really been feeling down or losing interest in the things I enjoy. My struggles are definitely more about my focus and organization rather than any kind of mood issues.
Do you often make careless mistakes, lose things, get easily distracted, or avoid tasks that require sustained mental effort?

I'm not really sure about making careless mistakes or losing things, but I definitely tend to avoid or put off tasks that require a lot of sustained mental effort. I feel a strong reluctance to even start projects that need long, focused concentration. That struggle is very real for me.
Can you give me an example of how these problems show up both at home and at work or school? For instance, do you miss deadlines, forget appointments, or have trouble finishing chores in both places?

Yes, it definitely happens in both settings. At work, I really struggle to organize my tasks and structure my projects, which makes managing my workload very difficult. At home, I often forget appointments and have a really tough time actually finishing chores.
Do you also often have trouble sustaining attention during conversations, reading, or meetings, or find that you don’t seem to listen even when someone is speaking directly to you?
I don't really experience that issue, to be honest. I haven't noticed having trouble listening when people talk to me, or paying attention during conversations and reading.
Do you often get distracted by unrelated thoughts or things going on around you, or find that you start tasks but leave them unfinished because your attention shifts?

No, I don't really get easily distracted by outside noises or thoughts, and I don't typically leave tasks unfinished once I actually get them started. My main difficulties are really with organizing tasks to begin with, avoiding things that take a lot of mental effort, or simply forgetting daily appointments and chores.
Do you often misplace things you need, like keys, your phone, paperwork, or other important items?
No, I wouldn't say I struggle with that. I actually manage to keep track of my keys, phone, and other important items pretty well.
